exclusions.source_text: The participant must be ≥ 18 years of age.
Synchronous diagnosis of another invasive cancer, other than this breast cancer, except for non-melanoma skin cancers.
Completed all therapy (including endocrine therapy) \<5 years ago for any previous invasive solid organ malignancy (with exception of non-melanoma skin cancers) including prior breast cancer.
Completed all therapy for any previous hematologic malignancy \< 5 years ago.
Known pregnancy at time of enrollment.
Definitive clinical or radiologic evidence of metastatic disease.
